scenes.voice: Kab tak dusro ki libraries use karoge? Aaj khud ka NPM package publish karte hain!
scenes.headline: BUILD YOUR OWN PACKAGE

scenes.voice: Step one: npm init se project setup karo aur TypeScript configure karo. Fir apna code likho...
scenes.headline: SETUP TYPESCRIPT

scenes.voice: ...jaise koi mast sa responsive layout kit ya shimmer effect. Yaad rakhna, types zaroor export karna, kyunki Developer Experience is king!
scenes.headline: DX IS KING

scenes.voice: Step two: package dot json mein entry points set karo. Step three: terminal mein npm publish maro, aur boom! Package duniya ke liye live.
scenes.headline: NPM PUBLISH

scenes.voice: Pro tip: GitHub Actions se CI/CD pipeline set kar lo taaki har push par package npm registry par auto-publish ho jaye.
scenes.headline: AUTO PUBLISH CI/CD

scenes.voice: Apna open-source empire banane ke liye techwith.GenZ ko follow kar lo!
scenes.headline: START YOUR EMPIRE
